fits_reason: Original Papers require actual biological data (simulation-only work needs an exceptional justification) and new methods need comparison with the state of the art. The paper has real literature-based cases, but no matched comparative performance baseline was located. No clinical-cohort or wet-lab requirement was found for this software article.

preprint_rule: The author's original preprint can be posted before submission; update its eventual published DOI. Related manuscripts (including under consideration elsewhere) must be disclosed in the cover letter, copied for editors, and distinguished. These rules allow separate companion papers; they do not require one paper's acceptance first.
